questions.stem: A 4-year-old boy is brought by his parents because of swelling and tenderness in his left upper arm after falling while playing 2 days ago. Both parents claim there is no history of previous trauma. The boy is at the 60th percentile for height and 40th percentile for weight. An X-ray of the arm and chest shows a nondisplaced spiral fracture of the left proximal humeral shaft and a fracture with callus formation of the left 8th rib. Which is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.label: B
options.text: Immobilization of the bone using a sling & follow-up after 4 weeks.
